title: Outdoor Cooked Mexican Prosciutto Tacos
description: A light and comforting Mexican dish featuring prosciutto, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware vessel and wrapped in corn husks, perfect for outdoor gatherings.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware vessel over medium heat outdoors.
In a small bowl, mix together lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the diced red onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the lime juice mixture.
Place a slice of prosciutto in the center of each corn tortilla.
Spoon some of the onion mixture onto the prosciutto.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the onion mixture.
Fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the taco to form a tight cylinder.
Wrap each taco in a corn husk, securing with a strip of corn husk if needed.
Place the wrapped tacos in the preheated earthenware vessel and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve the tacos hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
